name: BIG-Bench Mistake
description: A dataset of LLM-generated logical mistakes designed to benchmark the ability of large language models to find reasoning errors and to evaluate their correction abilities separately from mistake finding.
reputation: A specialized benchmark from the BIG-bench ecosystem that has seen some use in reasoning-error detection studies, but is not a mainstream leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Dataset focuses on logical mistake finding and correction in LLM outputs; includes a classifier trained on out-of-domain data to improve mistake-finding.
